references.text: The Jubilee year is instituted as the year when property shall be returned to its original owner, which directly relates to the return of land in the Jubilee.
In the Jubilee year, everyone shall return to their property, confirming the principle that land must be returned to the original owner.
Describes how sold property shall remain with the buyer until the Jubilee year, when it shall go back to the original owner.
Refers to land that is made holy to the Lord in the Jubilee and belongs to the priest as an inheritance, relevant for understanding property transfer in the Jubilee.
Mentions the Jubilee year in connection with inheritance and property rights, showing that inheritances shall remain within the tribes.
The prince's gift to a servant shall belong to the servant until the year of release, when it shall return to the prince, reflecting the principle of return in the Jubilee.
